hints.title: Subarray Amplitude Bound
hints.text: The difference between the maximum and minimum elements in any valid subarray cannot exceed two.

hints.title: Window Extrema Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the current window minimum and maximum using monotonic queues.

hints.title: Dynamic Contraction
hints.text: Advance the left boundary whenever the difference between extrema exceeds two, adding valid lengths to the total.

hints.title: Monotonic Queue Code

complexity.notes: Each index is added and removed from monotonic deques at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all subarrays naively takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual monotonic queues store window extrema in O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains sliding window extrema in amortized O(1) time.
